explication: torchforge is a PyTorch-native agentic reinforcement-learning library that separates algorithm work from distributed execution infrastructure. The principal workflow is the GRPO application: configure and provision resources, sample prompts, generate responses, grade rewards, compute advantages, and train from rollouts. The repository also includes an SFT training entry point, reusable dataset/tokenization and RL-loss components, scalable actor services, and metrics. The GRPO excerpt supports the main orchestration links; several runtime modules are represented from the source index and README capabilities, so unverified links are omitted.
